description: This file defines the SavedNewsDb class, which manages local database operations for storing, retrieving, updating, and deleting news articles in a Flutter application using the sqflite package.

classes.name: SavedNewsDb
classes.description: A class providing database operations for saved news articles, including initialization, insertion, deletion, and retrieval.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Ensures the database is initialized; if not, creates and sets up the database schema.

methods.name: _database
methods.description: Getter that returns the initialized database instance or throws if not initialized.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a news article in the database.

methods.name: deleteByHeadline
methods.description: Deletes a news article from the database identified by its headline.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all saved news articles from the database, ordered by time descending.
